name: release-0-5-0-decisions
body: v0.5.0 release-spec decisions. (1) Tree: version-command, changelog, license, brand-identity and new readme-presentation are contained by requirements.requirement.distribution (their feature=distribution). [autonomous] (2) Version output format: single line `kalide <version>` (e.g. `kalide v0.5.0`, `kalide dev`), for `version`, `--version` and `-v`, matching go/gh-style tools. [autonomous — flag for coordinator; question tool unavailable. Alternative: bare `v0.5.0`] (3) README: a sibling requirement readme-presentation rather than amending install-docs, because install-docs' AC is about install success and presentation/brand is a separate, separately testable concern; both realised by the existing solution.component.install-docs → README.md (body updated), so no new component. [autonomous] (4) Release-pipeline readiness: NO new spec node. The first-tag dry run is covered by the existing ACs of github-releases, native-ci-verification, package-manifest-update, homebrew-install, scoop-install, supported-platforms, tap-bucket-location, source-repo and install-docs; readiness is a plan-time verification against them (humans push the tag per global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag). [autonomous] (5) Domain: added domain.value.version and domain.value.brand-identity inside domain.group.distribution; values are realised through their group/entity (per solution.note.spine-values-and-tier4): release → cli-commands (version surface), changelog, license-notice; distribution group → brand-assets. [autonomous] (6) Solution: version folded into solution.component.cli-commands (already implemented-by internal/cli.Run). New components changelog and license-notice under release-pipeline; brand-assets under package-channels (docs/marketing surface), explicitly NOT under embedded-assets. Brand files live at repo-root `brand/`. [autonomous — flag for coordinator if another location is preferred] (7) implemented-by for CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, NOTICE and brand/* deliberately not authored: files do not exist; plan declares them as planned nodes. (8) Constraint: global constraints already forbid embedded logos and require an unbranded core, but frame it around templates/EY; a local requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded on brand-identity makes kalide's own brand boundary explicit rather than editing the globals. [autonomous] (9) NOTICE chosen as the third-party notice file name. [autonomous]
